title: XpAward
description: A per-participant experience-point grant for an event. The post-event awarding ritual produces one XpAward per grant: who earned how much, why, and who granted it. Awards feed the character's computed XP ability as a fifth stat-engine stage. Writes are restricted to game masters; reads are open to authenticated app users.

event.description: The event this award was granted for.

amount.description: The positive amount of experience points awarded.

reason.description: Optional reason for the award (e.g. full attendance, plot bonus).

awardedBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the game master who granted the award (server-stamped).
